name: Topaz Bible — KJV Modernized Word Forms

condition_language.previous_text_in: Previous token text must match one of these strings, case-insensitive.
condition_language.next_text_in: Next token text must match one of these strings, case-insensitive.
condition_language.previous_text_sequence_in: One of these token-text sequences must appear immediately before the matched token.
condition_language.next_text_sequence_in: One of these token-text sequences must appear immediately after the matched token.
condition_language.book_id_in: Matched token must be in one of these book ids.
condition_language.flags_include: Matched token must include all listed flags.
condition_language.strongs_in: Matched token primary Strong's number must be in this list.
condition_language.after_punctuation_present: Matched token's after-punctuation field (`a`) must be non-empty.
